userStories.title: Add paginate with keyset and offset modes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one paginate stage so that no source re-implements pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: Add paginate to media/pipeline supporting both modes: keyset (raw-query hop via nextRaw), offset (in-memory slice of the sorted set) (design §C/§E)
keyset mode preserves #500 (empty-streak -> cursor:null), #501 (single-pass sparse bucket+sort), and the RISK-005 OFFSET_FULL_LOAD_WARN_ROWS ceiling (invariant V.PG1)
Unit tests assert the empty-streak cursor:null invariant and the sparse-page invariant (asserts WHY per Rule 9)
`vp check` passes
`vp test` passes
userStories.notes: Created apps/server/src/media/pipeline/paginate.ts: the single paginate STAGE (design §C/§E) replacing the 3 forked paginators. Pure function `paginate({items, cursorMode, cursor, nextRaw, limit, log?}) -> {items, cursor}` (encoded next-page string). KEYSET mode: slice items to limit; next cursor = nextRaw===undefined ? null : encode({mode:keyset,k:nextRaw}). The SOURCE (US-014/015 fetchRawSet) owns the resume position — it threads the hop token into nextRaw and signals exhaustion (incl. #500 empty-streak give-up) by OMITTING nextRaw, so paginate emits cursor:null then (no phantom load-more, V.PG1/#500). OFFSET mode: start = incoming cursor.mode==='offset' ? cursor.n : 0; slice(start, start+limit); next = (start+page.length) < items.length ? encode({mode:offset,n}) : null. #501 preserved structurally: filter is now its own upstream pipeline stage over the FULL set, so paginate slices the whole filtered+sorted tail in one pass — no bounded overshoot window can strand sparse bucket+sort matches (verified by the home _shared.ts offset model: slice(off,off+size), hasMore = len > off+size). RISK-005 OFFSET_FULL_LOAD_WARN_ROWS=1000 (moved from watchlist listItemsOffset) advisory warn on the offset path; extracted to warnIfOverCeiling helper to keep paginateOffset under fallow's complexity threshold (cyclo 6->4; cursor.ts decode at cyclo 5 remains the only pre-existing complexity warn). Logger optional — missing log never throws. Exported paginate/OFFSET_FULL_LOAD_WARN_ROWS/PaginateInput/PaginateResult via media/index.ts barrel; test imports from ../pipeline/paginate (source) so fallow unused-exports (error) doesn't flag the value exports. 9 unit tests (__tests__/paginate.test.ts): keyset slice+mint, keyset #500 empty-streak cursor:null, keyset exhausted-with-items, offset first/resume/final pages, offset #501 sparse-tail single-pass, offset past-end, RISK-005 inclusive-ceiling warn boundary (1000 silent / 1001 warns), no-logger no-throw. vp check 0 errors / 1 pre-existing warning; vp test media 265 pass (+9); fallow vs origin/main: only Duplication+Complexity (both warn), no Circular/Boundaries/Unused (error) sections. userStories.notes:
Created apps/server/src/media/service/list-rows.ts (NEW file, NOT appended to service/index.ts per design §A): `listRows

(source, cfg, ctx)` — the single read path (design §C). Signature takes ctx (SourceContext) separately from cfg (PipelineConfig) since fetchRawSet is (ctx, params, cursor). Stages: fetchRawSet -> batchLoad(US-004) -> enrich(prefetchedBatch) -> applyBucketFilter -> sortItems -> paginate(US-006) -> Page. partial = raw.partial || batch.partial || enriched.partial (no throw on soft failure). DECISION (batchLoad+enrich wiring): added an OPTIONAL `prefetchedBatch?: {statuses, metadata, progress}` to EnrichOptions (enrich.ts) so the existing heavyweight `enrich` (which produces the WatchlistItem[]/CompactMediaItem[] wire shape + cold-fill + matching-servers + artwork) CONSUMES batchLoad's result instead of re-issuing its own status/metadata/progress fan-out. Faithful to design §C `enrich(rows, batch)`, single fan-out (test asserts getStatusBatch+getMetadataBatch each called ONCE), additive+non-breaking (existing callers omit prefetchedBatch -> byte-identical). US-024 removes enrich's standalone fan-out branch once consumers route through listRows. DECISION (SourceContext): added OPTIONAL `getArtwork?: GetArtworkFn` + `toCanonicalRow?: ToCanonicalRowFn` to SourceContext (types.ts) — enrich needs these consumer-injected callbacks (artwork↔media + catalog↔media cycle breakers; both consumers already build them in asWatchlistContext / home media-enrichment). SourceContext is the per-request context, the natural home; optional keeps US-007 isolation tests simple, consumers populate in US-014+/US-020+. DECISION (filter): bucket is a MEDIA concept (MediaRowBucket = WatchlistBucket), so added OPTIONAL `bucket?: MediaRowBucket` to PipelineConfig; the filter stage reads cfg.bucket (not opaque cfg.params) and keeps items where classifyBucket(item) === target. MOOD filtering stays SOURCE-SIDE (fetchRawSet) — media must not import watchlist deriveMoods (boundary) — so `filter: "mood"` falls straight through the pipeline (no-op). classify+filter:bucket together gate the bucket predicate. SORT: sortItems orders CompactMediaItem[] by addedAt per RowSort (recentDesc/recentAsc); items without addedAt (discovery feeds) compare equal -> stable sort preserves fetch order. Mapped nothing — ActiveRow is structurally a MediaEnrichRow (superset) so raw.rows pass straight to enrich (Row=ActiveRow). Exported listRows via media/index.ts barrel (direct `export {listRows} from "./service/list-rows"`, matching the pipeline-direct-export pattern of batchLoad/paginate). COMPLEXITY: initial listRows hit fallow HIGH (cyclo 9) — refactored into named stage helpers (applyBucketFilter, bucketTarget, sortItems, toPaginateInput, toBatchContext, toEnrichContext); listRows now cyclo 4, all helpers <=4 (threshold is >=5; fallow no longer flags list-rows at all). 8 unit tests (__tests__/list-rows.test.ts, env+plugin-runtime mocked like enrich-compact.test, __resetAvailabilityCache per ctx): full pipeline+offset-slice+single-fan-out assertion; keyset cursor minted from nextRaw; #500 keyset exhaustion -> cursor:null; source partial propagates; batch sub-load failure -> partial+still-returns-items; V.MC1 (unsorted+oversize source -> pipeline sorts+windows); classify+filter:bucket (future-year=upcoming kept, past-year=unavailable dropped); mood source not re-filtered. No consumer (home/watchlist) changed. vp check 0 errors / 1 pre-existing warn; vp test media 273 pass (+8); fallow vs origin/main: no Circular/Boundaries/Unused (error) sections, only inherited Duplication/Complexity (warn). Empty internal-only changeset (server-internal orchestration; CompactMediaItem wire change already in US-001 minor changeset).
